rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: Rovo renders no trust dialog for a launch, so the gate is never consulted for it. A plain Enter submits. Its composer is a bordered box, which the shared shape reader recognises without a harness name. A single Escape cancels the turn and prints its own cancelled row, with nothing restored into the composer. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. Rovo runs operator and Recon work only. While a turn runs the pane prints its own cancelled and activity rows; idle it prints its composer. No stored busy record is trusted, so its live reading is owned by bin/jg-busy-lib.sh.
